title: Activation Milestone Playbook — Hands-on Developer Onboarding
content:
Purpose:
Provide a practical, developer-first 30/60/90 milestone playbook for early-stage onboarding engagements. This doc is written for Customer Success Managers pairing with engineering/product contacts to drive meaningful activation on Redwood API and surface renewal signals early.

High-level outcomes (30/60/90):
- 30 days: customer has integrated a Redwood API route in a non-prod environment, served 1k tokens, and completed first latency/cost sanity check.
- 60 days: customer has shipped an internal demo or prototype using model variants and caching, and has a repeatable observability dashboard.
- 90 days: customer has a go-to-production plan (Dedicated request or hosted optimization) with clear cost estimates and a renewal signal baseline.

Success metrics (examples):
- Integration: API calls made (>= 2000 calls in 30 days)
- Latency: p50 < target SLA (as agreed) and p95 within 2x baseline
- Cost: tokens per successful user flow measured and compared to baseline recommendation
- Quality: end-to-end completion rate for sample prompts >= 85%
- Adoption: 3 internal stakeholders actively using demo/prototype

Quick pre-kickoff checklist (owner: CSM):
- Confirm primary engineer, Slack channel, and API key access scope
- Provision sandbox keys and register sample app in internal doc
- Share quickstart (curl + SDK) + sample prompt set
- Create shared dashboard skeleton (Grafana/Console link)

Kickoff agenda (45 minutes):
1) Introductions and success criteria (5m)
2) Integration flow review (5m): where the LLM sits in their stack
3) Quickstart run-through (10m): run curl sample together
   curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
     -H "Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_KEY>" 
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
     -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","input":"Summarize this architecture"}'
4) Observability + cost expectations (10m): show Console token breakdown and tracing
5) 30/60/90 milestones and owners (10m)
6) Next actions and blockers (5m)

30-day milestone (integration & baseline):
- Tasks:
  - Integrate SDK or curl route into non-prod pipeline (owner: Eng contact)
  - Create 3 canonical prompts that represent core user flows (owner: Product)
  - Enable request tracing and token-level cost logging (owner: Eng/Platform)
  - Run smoke load: 1k tokens over typical prompt set and capture p50/p95
- Deliverables: sandbox dashboard link, sample prompts repo, integration PR/branch link
- Typical blockers & mitigations:
  - API key scope issues: CSM to coordinate with security for key scope change
  - Unexpected latency: capture full request trace and open ticket with SRE (attach traces)

60-day milestone (prototype & observability):
- Tasks:
  - Ship internal demo that exercises 5 user journeys (owner: Eng/Product)
  - Turn on prefix caching for repeated prompts where applicable (owner: Eng)
  - Validate quality across model variants; run A/B prompts with baseline rubric (owner: Applied ML / Product)
  - Establish cost guardrails in Console (alerts at spend thresholds)
- Deliverables: demo recording, A/B results sheet, cost guardrail settings
- Signals for health: stable p50/p95, quality rubric passing, predictable spend per flow

90-day milestone (production readiness & renewal baseline):
- Tasks:
  - Finalize production deployment plan (hosted vs dedicated vs private) including capacity and SLA requirements
  - Run a 24-hour soak test at target traffic to validate autoscaling and billing estimates
  - Prepare a renewal signal pack: usage, latency, quality, and cost trendline
  - Schedule QBR prep with customer stakeholder list and agenda
- Deliverables: production runbook, cost estimate spreadsheet, renewal signal pack (one-pager)

CSM playbook snippets and email cadences:
- Day 3 follow-up (integration help): short checklist and links to quickstart repo and sandbox dashboard
- Day 14 check-in: ask for first smoke results, offer pairing session to debug traces
- Day 45 demo request: coordinate internal demo and record for execs
- Day 75 renewal signal preview: share draft signal pack and discuss value metrics

Renewal and risk signals to watch (early):
- Low API usage vs expected cohort: schedule call and surface adoption blockers
- Spiking p95 latency without corresponding traffic change: escalate to SRE and review model variant
- Costs trending above estimate and no cost guardrails: propose Optimize recommendations (quantization, batching)

Hand-off checklist (to renewals / account team):
- Ownership: list of internal stakeholders and product owner contact
- Baseline pack: usage graphs, demo recording, cost estimate, open issues backlog
- Suggested next steps: Dedicated capacity proposal or hosted optimization plan

Appendix - Template fields to copy into customer record:
- Primary engineer name, email, timezone
- Business-critical user flow and sample prompts
- Latency target (p50/p95), monthly token budget, quality acceptance threshold
- Recommended model family and initial variant

Notes and open questions: 
- Consider adding a short SDK integration video to reduce Day 1 friction
- Ask applied-ml to create a 1-page rubric template for quality regressions
- Track renewal lead time per customer cohort to refine 90-day cadence

Owner notes: This doc is intentionally focused on developer-first customers where early integration velocity and measurable signals matter. Use as skeleton for discovery calls; copy sections into customer-specific onboarding docs and Confluence templates.
